title: Nik's Craftables - Peaceful
description: Adds recipes to complete peaceful mode. Unlock recipes by crafting a Knowledge Book (Book + Emerald).
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds crafting recipes so you can complete the game in peaceful mode! Also adds recipes to make all hostile mob drops obtainable. Unlock all recipes by crafting a knowledge book.

<details>
<summary>Adds Recipes for:</summary>

- blaze rod
- bone
- breeze rod
- ender pearl
- ghast tear
- gunpowder
- magma cream
- nautilus shell
- nether star
- froglights
- phantom membrane
- prismarine crystals
- prismarine shards
- rotten flesh
- shulker shell
- slime ball
- spider eye
- sponge
- string
- totem of undying
- trident

</details>

## :P
